name: simple-price-tracker
description: Angular + NestJS price tracker — use npm run dev to start UI + API

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:full: npm run dev:db && npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
